text:
Zoe: Hi team — small weird onboarding questions before I start Monday remote from Canada: 1) Can I add my domestic partner to benefits and what's required? 2) I shipped my cat cross-border for the move  can I expense vet/inspection fees under relocation? 3) I have a dual-resident tax treaty question  should I talk to payroll or legal?

Ravi (People Ops): Welcome, Zoe! :wave: Short answers: dependents accepted with proof (domestic partnership form + ID). Relocation expenses can include pet transport if listed in your relocation packet  attach receipts and note "pet relocation." For tax treaty, payroll should be first touch; Legal gets looped if it's complex.

Elena (Benefits): Hi Zoe  domestic partner enrollment: upload a signed domestic partnership affidavit + partner ID to the benefits portal within 30 days. Premiums vary by carrier; we'll confirm once you submit. Coverage effective date follows the standard rule (1st of month after 30 days) unless a retro exception applies.

Zoe: Thanks  I have vet inspection receipts and a customs clearance invoice (both in CAD). Any special currency notes? Also I was told pet transport may need manager approval first?

Ravi (People Ops): Put everything in Expensely, select expense type "Relocation - Pet Transport" and include offerID in the note. Finance converts using company FX; if you prefer CAD payout, mention "CAD payout" and ensure your bank supports it. Manager approval isn't always required for small pet fees, but include your manager's ok in the expense comment to speed review.

Marco (Payroll Int): For the tax treaty: payroll-int handles residency withholding. DM me your country and dual-resident details; we may need a tax treaty form or a Certificate of Coverage. If it's treaty-related withholding change, we need docs before the payroll cutoff. Legal will review if there's ambiguity.

Zoe: Great  last tiny one: My direct deposit attempted to use my Canadian bank but portal flagged format. Is there a secure way to send IBAN/branch?

Marco (Payroll Int): Use the secure payroll portal banking tab. If it errors, open a secure ticket to payroll-int@redwood.example with subject "SECURE BANK - Zoe - <offerID>" and attach a bank letter or voided cheque PDF. Don't email bank details in plaintext. Cutoff is 48h before payday.

Onboard Bot: Checklist: benefits enrollment link sent; expense template created (Relocation - Pet Transport); payroll provisioning in progress. Link: https://onboard.redwood.example/zoe-1779

Zoe: Amazing, thanks everyone. I'll upload the partnership affidavit and receipts today and DM Marco about the tax treaty paperwork. Excited to start! :smile:
